item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 38 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 38 #SLPRSD
Issued at 01:40 AM 06 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(CityOfMasbate, Baleno), #CamarinesNorte(Capalonga), #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay, Bongabong and Bansud) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque, #Romblon(Concepcion, Banton, Corcuera, Romblon, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Calatrava, Odiongan, SantaMaria, Alcantara, Ferrol), #Masbate(Monreal, SanJacinto, Balud), #CamarinesNorte(Daet, Talisay, Vinzons, Paracale and JosePanganiban) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
